editorial.marketOverview: Sunday 02:17 EST: US cash equity markets remain closed. Friday's reported Nasdaq Composite -5.28%, SOX approximately -11% and secondary QQQ -5.67% reflect severe semiconductor-led liquidation, not Sunday price discovery. Barron's reported Friday VIX 37.66, while other reports differ. New synchronized price/volatility observations are unavailable.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with Sunday 01:05 EST, Sunday 02:17 EST review of fresh-indexed but previously published November 20–21 StoneX and Newsquawk reporting found no new material catalyst, revised verified price, or new Open Watch event. The existing Nvidia regulatory scrutiny and Friday selloff remain incorporated; no Sunday US cash-market response exists.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Bearish downside skew persists due to disproportionate semiconductor losses, weak approximate breadth and elevated reported Friday volatility. A reflex rebound is plausible but unconfirmed. Treasury 10Y/2Y +29bp proxy is stale, not a live curve; no defensible fresh FedWatch or matched oil data were obtained. Regulatory reports are potential catalysts, not proof of misconduct or isolated causal market reactions.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 23: assess QQQ/SOX/SMH relative strength, breadth and volatility around flash PMIs. Tuesday November 24: test rebound durability against consumer confidence and ADI/Dell earnings. Wednesday November 25: PCE, GDP, durable goods, claims and Beige Book create two-way event risk. Bearish base case persists absent synchronized repair in chips, breadth and volatility.
editorial.bullCase: Friday's extreme liquidation could generate short-covering. Confirmation would require QQQ and SOX/SMH advancing together, improving breadth, and declining VXN/VIX across sessions; falling synchronized Treasury yields would help but are unverified.
editorial.bearCase: Further SOX/SMH underperformance, negative breadth and persistent volatility could extend the drawdown. Upside inflation or hawkish repricing would amplify duration pressure if realized, not before.
